descripcion: A doglike ambush predator that has a clawed hand on the end of a long prehensile tail and drags victims into rivers to drown them.
motivos: Ambush, drown, restrain

rasgos.texto: When the Ahuizotl attacks from the water, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra **1d6** damage.
**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal **1d8+2** physical damage.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Ahuizotl grab a target within Close range with its tail, pull the target into Melee range, and temporarily _Restrain_ them. The Ahuizotl has advantage on attacks against targets _Restrained_ in this way.

descripcion: A majestic green water bird that has a ten-foot wingspan and is hunted for the fortune-telling stone inside their stomach.
motivos: Avoid, escape, misdirect

rasgos.texto: While the Atototl is flying, attacks against it is made with disadvantage.

Inside the Atototl is a stone that foretells good or ill fortune, depending on its color. A PC who searches the Atototl's remains finds the stone and makes a fate roll. On an even result, the PC gains Hope equal to half the result, which they can distribute among the PCs however they wish. On an odd result, you gain Fear equal to half the result.

When a creature beyond Very Close range would deal damage to the Atototl with a weapon attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make an attack roll against them. On a success, whirling winds reflect the attack and deal the attacker's damage back to them.

descripcion: A large bipedal creature that has a tusked snout and coarse fur.
motivos: Ambush, bully, seek carnage and shiny things

rasgos.texto: If the Bugboar makes its first attack in a scene before it's marked HP or Stress, it has advantage on the attack and deals an extra **1d8** damage.
When the Bugboar makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to deal an extra **1d6** damage.
When a condition would be imposed on the Bugboar, you can **spend a Fear** to negate it.

descripcion: A local laborer or artisan pushed by circumstances to assail others.
motivos: Do violence, seek security and survival

rasgos.texto: **Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Ruffians within Close range of them. The Ruffians move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal **1d8** physical damage each. Combine this damage.
When the Ruffian marks half their HP, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the Ruffian flees the scene. Otherwise, you gain a Fear.

descripcion: A spider the size of a human head, woven out of shadow-silk.
motivos: Hide in shadow, strike the unwary, wait for an opening

rasgos.texto: The Crawler is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 3 damage a PC deals to the Crawler, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
**Spend a Fear** to force all PCs within Melee range of the Crawler to **mark a Stress**.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Darkweave Crawlers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

When the Crawler makes a successful attack, you can **mark a Stress** to Exhaust the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (9). While Exhausted, the target must **mark a Stress** each time they make an action roll.

descripcion: A wagon-sized spider woven from shadow-silk by a long-forgotten god. Each of her many eyes bears the face of a different victim.
motivos: Ambush prey, climb the walls and ceiling, misdirect, paralyze, stash bodies away for later, steal faces

rasgos.texto: The Queen can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.
When a PC fails an attack roll against the Queen, you gain a Fear.
Once per scene, **spend 2 Fear** to summon up to two Darkweave adversaries (other than Darkweave Queens), who appear within Close range and immediately take the spotlight.
**Spend a Fear** to move up to Far range and make a standard attack with advantage.
When the Queen succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (12) or take a rest.

descripcion: A boar-sized arachnid woven from primordial shadow-silk.
motivos: Bite, stick to the darkness

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target is _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (10).

When the Spinner makes a successful attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target Shaky until they succeed on an Instinct Roll (10). While Shaky, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls.

descripcion: A teeming swarm of tiny spiders woven out of shadow-silk.
motivos: Burst out of holes, climb up legs, crawl into ears, scuttle under clothes

rasgos.texto: When the Swarmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4** physical damage instead.

When an attack from the Swarmlings causes a target to mark HP, you can **mark a Stress** to make the target temporarily Covered in Spiders. While Covered in Spiders, the target must roll a d6 when they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or higher, they must **mark a Stress** or you gain a Fear.

descripcion: A large deer.
motivos: Bound away, graze, rut, sense danger

rasgos.texto: When the Elk moves from Close range or farther before making a standard attack, it deals **1d12+2** physical damage instead of its standard damage.
When the Elk marks a HP or Stress, it must succeed on a Reaction Roll (10) or flee the scene.

descripcion: A bird of prey that has long, pointed wings and a notched beak.
motivos: Circle, clutch, dive, spy

rasgos.texto: While flying, the Falcon gains a +3 bonus to its Difficulty.
**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target from above. The Falcon gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls.

descripcion: A cluster of small, strange creatures wearing armor fashioned from trash and stolen housewares.
motivos: Ambush, celebrate a little too early, hit and run, infight, sabotage, sow chaos

rasgos.texto: When the Warband has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.
When the Warband marks its last Stress or an allied Leader is defeated, roll a d6. On a result of 2 or lower, the Warband flees the scene.

descripcion: A fierce and foul-smelling bird with an eight-foot wingspan and the upper body and face of a human.
motivos: Defend nest, drop enemies from a great height, maraud from the air, screech incessantly

rasgos.texto: The Harpy emits a foul stench that renders all non-Harpies _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.
**Mark a Stress** to have the Harpy move in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against a target in the Harpy's path. On a success, the Harpy deals **3d6** physical damage.

descripcion: A river-dwelling shapeshifter who prefers an enchanting equine form in and out of the water.
motivos: Adopt an attractive or useful shape, drown and devour, entice unwary travelers

rasgos.texto: A PC must **mark a Stress** to move out of the Kelpie's Melee range.
After the Kelpie interacts with or watches a creature for at least a hundred heartbeats, the Kelpie knows the physical form that creature would find most pleasing or alluring.

**Mark a Stress** to change the Kelpie's physical form into any creature or object smaller than a wagon. A creature has disadvantage on rolls against the Kelpie while the Kelpie is in a form the creature finds pleasing or alluring.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Kelpie beguile a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Enchanted until they take damage. While Enchanted, the PC perceives the Kelpie as a trusted friend or ally and will do what the Kelpie says unless it contradicts the PC's most deeply held morals.

descripcion: The raging soul of a villainous masked wrestler.
motivos: Call out, embarrass, energize the audience, pin opponents to the ground

rasgos.texto: The Masque Muerte can't be _Restrained_.

**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target must **mark a Stress** and is temporarily _Vulnerable_ as the Masque Muerte assaults them with a string of insulting taunts.
**Spend a Fear** to have the Masque Muerte suplex a _Restrained_ PC, dealing **1d10+6** magic damage to them.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Masque Muerte momentarily remove their mask, revealing their horrifying face underneath. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or **mark a Stress**.

When the Masque Muerte deals damage to a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to have a spectral wrestler appear and Pin the target until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Pinned, the target is _Restrained_ and takes an extra **1d12** magic damage from the Masque Muerte's attacks.

descripcion: A floating clockwork sphere that has telescoping limbs and comes from a realm of machines and metal.
motivos: Coordinate, (dis)assemble, move orthogonally, speak in binary

rasgos.texto: The Mechanorb gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each other Mechanorb within Close range.

Pool. When the Mechanorb fails an attack roll, add a token to the Mechanorb Pool. All Mechanorbs in the scene gain a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens in the Mechanorb Pool. Clear all tokens when any Mechanorb takes Severe damage or is defeated.

descripcion: A hideous giant born out of a massive rock. They wear purloined armor and a belt of severed heads or skulls.
motivos: Ambush, bellow, hurl large boulders, smash, stomp

rasgos.texto: The Troll can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

Countdown. When combat begins, activate a countdown with a value equal to the number of PCs. When the Troll takes damage, reduce the severity by one threshold, then tick down the countdown. When it triggers, the Troll evolves (see "Enraged Mountain Troll").
**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against all targets in front of the Troll within Very Close range. Targets the Troll succeeds against take **2d8+2** physical damage.

The Troll loses their "Stolen Armor" and "Flail Swipe" features, then gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty. Additionally, they gain the "Double Swipe" feature and replace "Skull Flail" with the following standard attack: Claw Swipe: Very Close | 1d10+3 phy
**Spend a Fear** to move up to Close range and make two standard attacks against a target within Melee range. If both attacks succeed, combine the damage, and the target loses a Hope.

descripcion: An aquatic, soft-bodied mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
motivos: Crawl along the ocean floor, eat fish, squirt ink to escape

rasgos.texto: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Octopus squirt ink. On land, the ink covers the ground within Very Close range. Each creature who moves through that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or slip and fall, becoming _Vulnerable_ until they exit the area. If this feature is used while the Octopus is underwater, it instead creates a cloud of darkness that fills an area within Very Close range and blocks line of sight.

descripcion: A large feline predator that stalks its prey from the shadows.
motivos: Climb trees, pounce, stalk

rasgos.texto: While _Hidden_, the Panther gains a +2 bonus to its attack rolls.
**Mark a Stress** to have the Panther leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **1d12+2** physical damage.

descripcion: The echo of a lost soul in the form of an ectoplasmic shadow.
motivos: Create cold spots, swoop through the air, whisper dark tidings

rasgos.texto: The Phantom has resistance to physical damage and can move through solid objects.
A PC who takes the spotlight within Very Close range of the Phantom must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (10) or **mark a Stress**.
When the Phantom is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, clear the Phantom's HP and immediately spotlight them.

descripcion: A baleful, translucent spirit that possesses inanimate objects.
motivos: Flicker candles, rattle chains, shake windows, throw people around the room

rasgos.texto: The Poltergeist has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Poltergeist inhabit a nonmagical object that is entirely within Close range, infusing the object with a ghostly glow. The next time the Poltergeist would take damage, the object is destroyed instead, and the Poltergeist is expelled from it.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Poltergeist pull all unequipped nonmagical objects within Very Close range into a violent vortex. Each target in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **1d12+2** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

descripcion: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a "mawb" of a dozen.
motivos: Chitter and chew, clump together, roll around

rasgos.texto: When the Rabble Mawb has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d4+1** physical damage instead.

When the Rabble Mawb is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.

descripcion: A troop of fist-sized fey creatures who have needle-sharp teeth and conical red caps sealed on their heads with candle wax.
motivos: Bring 'em down, celebrate tiny victories, giggle and chitter, scamper between the walls

rasgos.texto: When the Biters have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **1d4+2** physical damage instead.
A PC must **mark a Stress** to move out of the Biters' Melee range.

descripcion: A large, brutish fey creature who has a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motivos: Beat chest and bellow, ragdoll puny enemies, rush forward recklessly

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **3d4+10** physical damage. A target who marks HP from this attack is _Restrained_ until they clear a HP.
When the Breaker makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target temporarily _Vulnerable_.

descripcion: A halfling-sized fey creature who hacks their victims apart with a variety of cutting implements. They wear a conical red hat sealed on their head with candle wax.
motivos: Grin disconcertingly, hack and slash, scramble

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against up to three targets. For each target who marks HP, you gain a Fear.
**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target within Far range. If the Butcher is _Hidden_, they make the attack with advantage.

descripcion: A pale, gaunt cult leader wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax. They wield a long rod with a candle atop it made from a hanged criminal's hand.
motivos: Cast long shadows, keep out of the fray, show them the light

rasgos.texto: When the Candlemaker appears, place 5 tokens on this stat block. Remove a token whenever the Candlemaker marks a HP. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, the Candlemaker is _Hidden_.

The light of the Candlemaker's Hand of Glory inspires bloodlust in their allies. While this stat block has 1 or more tokens on it, each Redcap adversary within Close range gains a +1 bonus to their damage rolls.

Spend a token from this stat block. The Candlemaker conjures a ball of fire on a group of PCs within Far range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **2d10** magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

descripcion: A cat-sized fey creature wielding a straight razor and wearing a conical red cap sealed on their head with candle wax.
motivos: Flense, giggle, scrape, slice

rasgos.texto: The Skinner is defeated when they take any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Skinner, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
When a PC fails a roll, they take 1 physical damage for each Skinner within Melee range of them. Combine this damage.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Redcap Skinners within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 2 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descripcion: A wolf-headed humanoid cursed by the gods to prowl the swamps in search of blood.
motivos: Blaspheme, go for the throat, stalk, terrorize

rasgos.texto: The Rugaru can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
While in moonlight, the Rugaru gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty.

When a PC marks HP from the Rugaru's standard attack, add a token to this stat block. The Rugaru gains a bonus to attack rolls equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. Clear all tokens when the Rugaru takes Severe damage.

**Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range to make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). Targets who fail lose a Hope. Gain a Fear for each Hope lost. If a PC has no Hope, they must **mark a Stress** and become _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.
**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **1d12+2** direct physical damage.

descripcion: A stocky fish creature that has rows of razor-sharp teeth.
motivos: Clamber ashore, hit and run, peek above the waterline

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **1d12** physical damage and must mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefit (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

When a creature marks HP, you can **spend a Fear** to spotlight all Sawtoothed Gillbeasts within Very Close range of them. Those Gillbeasts move into Melee range of the creature and each make a standard attack against them. If any attacks succeed, combine their damage.
When the Gillbeast would **mark any number of HP**, roll a d6. On a result of 6, you can **mark a Stress** instead.

descripcion: A spellcaster with a psyche broken by knowledge best left hidden.
motivos: Babble in an unknown language, laugh unsettlingly, wield power beyond control

rasgos.texto: The Mage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

**Mark a Stress** to roll a d6. The Mage uses the corresponding move: 1–2: Dimension Rift. Choose a target within Far range. The target teleports to a point you choose within Close range of their original position and takes **2d6** direct magic damage as their body and mind reassemble. 3–4: Time Dilation. Choose a group of PCs within Far range. Each target is Slowed until they roll with Hope. While Slowed, a target is _Vulnerable_ and must **mark a Stress** when they move. 5–6: Discordant Visions. Make an attack against up to three targets within Close range. Targets the Mage succeeds against take **2d8** direct magic damage.
When the Mage marks HP, roll a number of d6s equal to the number of Stress the Mage has marked. The Mage deals direct magic damage equal to the total result to all PCs within Very Close range.

descripcion: An empty suit of full plate armor that glows with a faint corona of ghostly light.
motivos: Clank noisily, move like clockwork, watch silently

rasgos.texto: The Armor can't be forced to mark Stress. When an effect would cause it to mark Stress, the Armor ignores that part of the effect.
Once per scene when the Armor is defeated, you can **spend a Fear** to reactivate it. Clear 2 HP and immediately spotlight it.

descripcion: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.
motivos: Lie in wait, slither, strike

rasgos.texto: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily Envenomated. While Envenomated, the target must **mark a Stress** whenever they make an action roll.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

descripcion: A ten-foot-tall, semisolid (and semisentient) candle wax construct.
motivos: Lumber menacingly, moan with the pain of unlife, smother

rasgos.texto: The Creation can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.
The Creation doesn't take extra damage from attacks that critically succeed against it.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Creation throw a ball of wax at a target within Far range. Make an attack against the target. On a success, the target takes **1d12+2** physical damage and becomes _Restrained_ until they succeed on a Strength Roll (15).

When a PC within Melee range of the Creation makes a weapon attack against it, roll a d6. On a 5 or higher, the attacker's weapon gets stuck in the Creation and can be removed only with a successful Strength Roll (15).

When the Creation makes a successful standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to Trap the target inside the Creation's wax body. While Trapped, the target is _Restrained_ and must **mark a Stress** and move with the Creation each time it's spotlighted. A Trapped creature is freed when the Creation takes Major or greater damage.

descripcion: Lazily floating orbs of color-shifting werelight.
motivos: Dazzle and distract, disorient, lead astray

rasgos.texto: When the Will-o'-the-Wisps have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4-1 magic damage instead.

The Will-o'-the-Wisps pulse and dance in hypnotic, color-changing patterns that entrance any creature who looks upon them. All targets within Very Close range of the Will-o'-the-Wisps are _Vulnerable_.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Will-o'-the-Wisps trace looping light trails through the air, leaving afterimages that beg to be deciphered. Each PC within Far range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (13) or **mark a Stress** and move up to Close range toward the Will-o'-the-Wisps.

descripcion: A large, interdimensional jellyfishlike creature that floats in and out of the timestream.
motivos: Exchange information about possible timelines, feed on heightened emotions, watch from the shadows

rasgos.texto: The Yufo can mentally communicate with creatures within Very Far range.
The Yufo is immune to abilities and features that would affect or alter its thoughts or emotions.

**Spend a Fear** and choose up to three targets within Close range. Each target must succeed on a Instinct Reaction Roll or become desynced from reality and have disadvantage on Instinct Rolls until they use a downtime move to ground their psyches in the now.

When the Yufo succeeds on a standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Yufo excrete an entropic acid through its skin, giving the target a -2 penalty to their damage thresholds until they use a downtime move to repair their armor.

descripcion: A corrupted fey spirit that haunts the night in the form of a willowy specter wearing a luminous gossamer gown.
motivos: Ambush from inside solid objects, frighten to death, mourn life and beauty lost, scream balefully

rasgos.texto: The Banshee has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.
When the Banshee makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

Up to three times per scene, **spend a Fear** to have the Banshee teleport up to Very Far range and scare a PC within Melee range. The PC marks 1d4 Stress. If this causes them to mark HP, they also lose a Hope.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Banshee unleash a mournful scream of pain and anguish. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d12+1** magic damage. Targets who fail take double damage and are knocked back to Close range.

descripcion: A six-legged monitor lizard that has the head of a vulture, a spiked backbone, and a petrifying gaze.
motivos: Move slow and steady, savor petrified prey, turn everyone to stone, watch and wait

rasgos.texto: **Spend a Fear** to force a PC within Far range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a success, the target marks a Stress. On a failure, the target becomes Stiff. If the target is already Stiff, they become Petrified. While Stiff, the PC must **mark a Stress** each time they act until they take a rest or the Basilisk is defeated. While Petrified, the PC can't act. The Petrified condition can be cleared only by applying Basilisk saliva to the target.
**Mark a Stress** to have the Basilisk chomp down on a Petrified PC within Melee range. The target must make a death move.

descripcion: A veteran commander who quaffs magic elixirs to change into a beast and lead their packmates on a hunt.
motivos: Embrace the change, howl at the moon, lead the pack, run down enemies

rasgos.texto: The Alpha gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.
Once per scene, **spend a Fear** to have each ally within Close range of the Alpha clear a HP and a Stress.
The first time in a scene the Alpha marks their last Stress, they gain a +6 bonus to damage rolls.

descripcion: A raging warrior who imbibes ritualistic concoctions to enhance their form with aspects of a predatory beast.
motivos: Coordinate with packmates, dance around the fire, howl at the moon

rasgos.texto: The Initiate gains a +1 bonus to their attack rolls for each ally within Very Close range of their attack's target.
The first time in a scene the Initiate marks their last Stress, they gain a +4 bonus to damage rolls.

descripcion: A half-human, half-horse guardian who patrols the borders of idyllic lands uncorrupted by the touch of civilization.
motivos: Live in harmony with nature, protect the wilderness, use mobility and distance to drive off intruders

rasgos.texto: When the Warden makes a standard attack against a target within Melee range of one or more of the Warden's allies, the Warden gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.
**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack. The Warden has advantage on the attack roll and critically succeeds on a roll of 19–20.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Warden gallop up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in their path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take **1d6+2** physical damage. Targets who fail take double damage and must **mark a Stress**.
When the Warden makes a standard attack, you can **mark any number of Stress** to target an equal number of additional creatures within range.

descripcion: A tall wooden shack that moves around on giant chicken legs.
motivos: Claw, protect master, run and jump, trample

rasgos.texto: The Hut can move up to Far range when spotlighted.
**Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.
When the Hut makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to temporarily _Restrain_ the target. The Hut drags the _Restrained_ target when it moves.

descripcion: A carriage-sized pangolin-coati hybrid covered in armor plating. It has a bladed tail it uses to fling razor-sharp scales.
motivos: Escape with a meal, slice and dice, wade into danger

rasgos.texto: When the Pangolati makes a successful attack against a PC, that PC must mark an additional Armor Slot to reduce the severity of the damage.
**Spend a Fear** to have the Pangolati quickly spin in a circle. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** physical damage.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Pangolati flick its tail and fling a razor-edged armor plate. Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, the attack deals **2d6+10** physical damage.
When the Pangolati would mark HP from an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to reduce the number of HP it marks by 1.

descripcion: A vicious magical canid that has glowing eyes and two barbed, whiplike tails. It confuses enemies by conjuring an illusory duplicate of itself.
motivos: Ambush prey, kill for sport, play with food, trick and deceive

rasgos.texto: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate's. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate's place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you **spend a Fear** to conjure it again.
**Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

descripcion: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.
motivos: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off-balance, strike from above

rasgos.texto: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra **1d12** damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).
When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to reroll the attack with advantage.

descripcion: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.
motivos: Eat vegetation, protect the herd, socialize

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d10+3** physical damage.
When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra **1d12** damage.

descripcion: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther's skull for a head.
motivos: Rush attack, shred, terrify

rasgos.texto: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must **mark an additional HP**.

**Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become Rattled until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a Rattled PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the Rattled condition from the target.

When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.
When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against that PC.

descripcion: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.
motivos: Form up, protect the empress, strike as one

rasgos.texto: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.
Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal **2d6+2** physical damage.

descripcion: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She's been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.
motivos: Command inferiors, curse the invaders

rasgos.texto: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.
The Empress's internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals **2d8** physical damage, and temporarily Restrains them.
Up to three times per scene, you can **spend a Fear** to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.
When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

descripcion: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress's life beyond death.
motivos: Boost allies, conquer time, hold down enemies, serve the empress, wield death as a weapon

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC's feet and _Restrain_ them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target _Restrained_ in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark 1d4 Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

descripcion: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.
motivos: Carpet the ground, consume the living, crawl under clothing

rasgos.texto: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d4+1** physical damage instead.
When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

**Mark a HP** to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to **mark a Stress** and Infecting them. While Infected, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

descripcion: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress's tomb from the inside.
motivos: Never stop working, sacrifice yourself for the empress

rasgos.texto: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.
When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can **spend a Fear** to clear the Stonemason's HP and Stress.

descripcion: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.
motivos: Caw incessantly, claw faces, flutter through the air, peck eyes

rasgos.texto: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals **1d6+1** magic damage instead.

**Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become _Vulnerable_ until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

descripcion: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.
motivos: Drive prey into an ambush, fight to the death, hunt in pairs

rasgos.texto: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.
**Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must **mark a Stress**, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become _Vulnerable_ until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must **mark a Stress** or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

descripcion: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.
motivos: Avoid violence, spray attackers

rasgos.texto: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.
**Spend a Fear** to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

descripcion: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.
motivos: Awaken the fallen, defend the colony, spread spores

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become Poisoned until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While Poisoned, a target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must **mark a Stress**.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.
**Mark any number of Stress** to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

descripcion: A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon.
motivos: Hide in plain sight, overwatch, swoop down

rasgos.texto: The Gargoyle has resistance to magic damage.
Choose a point within Far range. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become _Vulnerable_. If the target is already _Vulnerable_, they become _Restrained_. If the target is already _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_, they must make a death move. The PC can spend a Hope per condition to clear it.

descripcion: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.
motivos: Crush and bite, grapple, harry sailing vessels, hunt prey

rasgos.texto: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

When the Octopus first appears, place a d8 on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die's value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die's value by 1.

When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Octopus Grapple the target. While Grappled, the target is _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.
**Mark a Stress** to deal **3d8** direct physical damage to a target Grappled by the Octopus.

descripcion: A fleshy, floating ball of teeth that has numerous eyes and a bundle of questing mouth tentacles that shoot magic beams.
motivos: Ambush rivals, seek riches, shoot beams

rasgos.texto: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

The Gobstalker's rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

**Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a d8 for a random beam attack or **spend a Fear** to choose instead: 1. Beguile. The Gobstalker Beguiles the target. While Beguiled, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can't attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a Beguiled PC must **mark a Stress** or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A Beguiled PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition. 2. Corrode. The target takes **2d8** magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can't, double the damage. 3. Doom. The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount. 4. Hypnosis. The target falls into a Deep Trance and can't act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16). 5. Paralyze. The target freezes in place, becoming _Vulnerable_ and _Restrained_ until they **mark 2 Stress**. 6. Sear. The target takes **2d8** direct magic damage. 7. Scare. The target is Scared. While Scared, the target can't take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must **mark a Stress** whenever you **spend a Fear**. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16). 8. Slow. The target becomes _Vulnerable_ and must **mark a Stress** to move until they spend 2 Hope.
On a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to clear a number of Stress equal to the number of HP the target marked.

descripcion: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.
motivos: Destroy, give no quarter, ravage

rasgos.texto: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.
**Spend a Fear** to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily Panicked. While Panicked, a PC must **mark a Stress** when they take the spotlight.

**Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can **mark a Stress** to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.
When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can **spend a Fear** to force all targets within Close range to **mark a Stress**.

descripcion: A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle.
motivos: Bolster allies, lead the pack, rally the troops

rasgos.texto: Pool. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can spend a token from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

**Spend 2 Fear** to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.
When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

descripcion: A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features.
motivos: Escape, profit, throw smoke

rasgos.texto: **Spend a Fear** to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.
**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

descripcion: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.
motivos: Protect, sacrifice, surround

rasgos.texto: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.
When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.

descripcion: A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features.
motivos: Abjure, bolster, summon

rasgos.texto: **Spend a Fear** to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.
**Spend a Fear** to have the Spirit Singer summon 2d4 Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and immediately spotlight one.

**Mark a Stress** to spotlight any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and have each one move into Melee range with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.
When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within Very Close range of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can **spend a Fear** to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

descripcion: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.
motivos: Eat, make a mess, patrol stomping grounds

rasgos.texto: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.
PCs are _Vulnerable_ while within Very Close range.
**Spend a Fear** to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

descripcion: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.
motivos: Encase prey in honey, protect the hive

rasgos.texto: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **2d8** magic damage and become temporarily _Restrained_ as the honey hardens on them.

When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take **1d8** direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. _Restrained_ targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

descripcion: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.
motivos: Bite, float, laugh, tell spooky stories

rasgos.texto: The Jack-o'-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o'- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o'-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.
When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can **mark a Stress** to gain an additional Fear.

descripcion: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.
motivos: Burrow, burst out of the ground, circle prey

rasgos.texto: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can't attack.
When the Landshark would be forced to **mark any number of HP**, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

descripcion: A landshark that's lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.
motivos: Bite, burrow, burst out of the ground

rasgos.texto: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.
The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can't attack.
All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming _Vulnerable_ until they make an action roll. For each PC made _Vulnerable_ in this way, you gain a Fear.

descripcion: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.
motivos: Ambush, lie in wait, swallow without chewing, take on an unassuming shape

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and _Restrained_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can **spend a Fear** to activate the Mockery's Devour feature against the target.

Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is _Restrained_ and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.
**Spend a Fear** to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

descripcion: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.
motivos: Avoid detection, eat rust, sniff out metal

rasgos.texto: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or **mark a Stress**.

The Rust Eater's carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon's damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon's damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

descripcion: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.
motivos: Pull yourself together, scratch and claw

rasgos.texto: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.
**Spend a Fear** to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing **2d8** magic damage and making them _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

descripcion: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.
motivos: Avoid detection, let the poison do its work, protect the wilderness

rasgos.texto: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.
**Spend a Fear** to make the Sprite _Hidden_ until they attack.

When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must **mark 2 Stress** or fall asleep until they take damage.

descripcion: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.
motivos: Blend into the rocks, craft and contemplate, pursue prophecy and solitude

rasgos.texto: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
Before the Titan makes an attack, you can **mark a Stress** and roll a d6. On a result of 3 or higher, the target's Evasion is halved against this attack.
When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a d4. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.
When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

descripcion: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.
motivos: Eat ferns, move in herds for protection, patrol the watering hole

rasgos.texto: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can **mark any number of Stress** instead of an equal number of HP.

**Mark a Stress** to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **5d6** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.
**Mark a Stress** to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal **3d10** direct physical damage.

descripcion: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.
motivos: Break through the treeline, eat, stomp around

rasgos.texto: **Spend a Fear** to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.
**Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **3d12** direct physical damage.
When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to force the target to **mark an additional HP**.

descripcion: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.
motivos: Feed, frighten, hunt

rasgos.texto: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.
The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.
**Spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can **spend any number of Fear** to clear the same number of HP.
When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can **spend a Fear** to cause the attacker's damage thresholds to gain a -1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

descripcion: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.
motivos: Collect souls, fly, vex trespassers

rasgos.texto: Once per scene, summon 2d4 Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You gain a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

**Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax's hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target's shadow and drains their essence. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a d6. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.
After a PC makes a roll, you can **mark a Stress** to force them to reroll it. This feature can't be used if the PC critically succeeds.

descripcion: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.
motivos: Corrupt, destroy, overwhelm with evil power

rasgos.texto: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

**Spend any number of Fear** and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.
**Mark any number of Stress** to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take **4d10** magic damage.

When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can **spend a Fear** to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll's result. On a success, the PC's Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can't Counterspell a critical success.

descripcion: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.
motivos: Dominate the conversation, seek attention, steal everything

rasgos.texto: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

**Spend a Fear** to turn the Catrin's gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they're carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.
When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

descripcion: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion's head, a goat's body, and a serpent's tail.
motivos: Play with food, prowl territory, slay cattle

rasgos.texto: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.
**Mark a Stress** to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

**Spend a Fear** to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take **3d12** magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can **mark a Stress** to attack the PC first. On a success, deal **4d4+10** physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must **mark a Stress**.

descripcion: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.
motivos: Be cute, go for the throat, hop around

rasgos.texto: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.
When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **3d20** direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become _Vulnerable_ until they clear a HP.
When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

descripcion: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.
motivos: Echolocate, fly silently, melt into the shadows

rasgos.texto: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

**Spend 2 Fear** to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take **3d8** direct magic damage and become _Vulnerable_ until their next rest. Targets who succeed must **mark a Stress** or take half damage.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren't Cryptimoths are _Vulnerable_ while inside that area and must **mark a Stress** to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

**Spend a Fear** to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can't Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

descripcion: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.
motivos: Separate enemies, strike from the shadows, use aquatic environment to advantage

rasgos.texto: The Merfolk is _Vulnerable_ out of the water.
The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can **spend a Fear** to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

descripcion: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.
motivos: Abuse power, seek worship, stalk sunken ruins

rasgos.texto: **Spend a Fear** to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed **mark a Stress**. Targets who fail take **3d10+4** direct magic damage and are _Vulnerable_ until spotlighted.
**Mark a Stress** to choose a _Vulnerable_ PC within Very Close range. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.
**Spend 2 Fear** to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is _Restrained_ until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs _Restrained_ in this way take **3d8** direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures _Restrained_ by it when it's defeated or takes Severe damage.

descripcion: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.
motivos: Coil and crush, protect master, slither around lairs and ruins, strike first

rasgos.texto: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake's new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

descripcion: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.
motivos: Doom with a glance, gallop across water, kick with heavy hooves

rasgos.texto: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. **Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range through solid objects.

While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you **mark a Stress** to summon it again. The Dullahan is _Vulnerable_ while not on their horse.
**Mark a Stress** to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes **4d4+10** direct physical damage and is _Vulnerable_ until they clear a HP.

**Spend a Fear** to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they **mark a Stress**. On a failure, they **mark a HP** and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

descripcion: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.
motivos: Find magic items, inspire fear, patrol skies

rasgos.texto: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he's knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you **mark a Stress** to summon it again.
The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.
The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

**Spend 2 Fear** to have the Shadow King's mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must **mark a Stress**. Targets who fail must **mark a Stress** and lose a Hope. If a PC can't lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.
Three times per scene, you can **spend a Fear** to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.

descripcion: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.
motivos: Act valorously, make war, think tactically

rasgos.texto: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.
When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
**Mark a Stress** to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take **3d12** physical damage.

**Mark a Stress** to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal **3d20+5** direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.
When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can **spend a Fear** and **mark any number of Stress** to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

descripcion: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.
motivos: Claim trophies, raid and pillage, test mettle

rasgos.texto: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
**Mark a Stress** to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or **mark a Stress** and become _Vulnerable_ until after the next attack against them.
**Mark a Stress** to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal **4d10+2** physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.
When a PC marks HP from the Titan's standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.
When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC's most valuable possession as a trophy.

descripcion: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.
motivos: Acquire riches, capsize trading vessels, lie in wait, use the waves as cover

rasgos.texto: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.
When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

**Mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra **1d12** physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take **4d8** physical damage, and become temporarily _Vulnerable_. Targets who succeed must **mark a Stress**. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

**Spend 2 Fear** to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **4d8** magic damage and become temporarily _Vulnerable_. Targets who succeed must choose to either **mark a Stress** or take half damage.

descripcion: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.
motivos: Attack the unaware, avoid sunlight, leech life force, put to sleep, slither through tall grass

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is _Restrained_ and must **mark a Stress** when the Lamia takes the spotlight.
**Mark a Stress** to force a _Vulnerable_ or _Restrained_ target within Melee range to mark 1d4-1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.
When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can **spend a Fear** to make them _Vulnerable_ until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).

descripcion: A huge aquatic creature that lures unwary prey into eating range with its dangling, shapeshifting head stalk.
motivos: Entice with secret knowledge, snap the trap shut, speak through a shapeshifted head stalk

rasgos.texto: The membranous cluster at the end of the Beguiler's head stalk can shapeshift into any humanoid form. **Mark a Stress** to choose a PC within Close range. Their player must tell you who their PC would find most trustworthy. The Beguiler's head stalk transforms into that person and gains the ability to speak in their voice.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Beguiler make an alluring overture to a PC within Close range. The PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll (18) or move into Melee range with the Beguiler. If the Beguiler's head stalk is transformed into a person the PC would find trustworthy, they have disadvantage on the reaction roll.

When a PC moves within Melee range, you can **spend a Fear** to make an attack roll against them. On a successful attack, the target takes **3d6** physical damage and is Swallowed. While Swallowed, the target is _Restrained_ and takes **3d6** physical damage when the Beguiler takes the spotlight. The Beguiler disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

descripcion: A legendary beast that has a human's face, lion's body, scorpion's tail, and dragon's wings.
motivos: Bite, claw, pounce, riddle, swipe, swoop, trick

rasgos.texto: The Manticore can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.
The Manticore is obsessed with puzzles and can be distracted by brain teasers, word games, or other semi-intellectual diversions.
While airborne, the Manticore gains a +2 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Manticore pounce into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal **3d20+6** physical damage, and the target becomes Shaky until they spend a Hope. While Shaky, the target makes attack rolls with disadvantage.

**Mark a Stress** to make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes **3d8** physical damage and becomes _Restrained_ until they overcome the toxin with a successful Strength Roll.

When the Manticore succeeds on a standard attack against a target within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to lock their jaws onto the target, making the target _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they escape with a successful Strength Roll (19).

descripcion: A teeming assortment of nocturnal fiends under the thrall of an ancient evil.
motivos: Carry victims back to master, overrun settlements, slither through shadow

rasgos.texto: When the Night Children have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals **2d6+2** physical damage instead.

Once per scene, **mark any number of Stress** to have the Night Children open a portal that spews forth reinforcements, refilling the Horde's ranks. Clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.
When the Night Children mark HP from an attack within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make a standard attack against the attacker.

descripcion: A member of an other-dimensional religious order devoted to exploring the boundaries of mortal suffering and ecstasy.
motivos: Feed on emotions, locate the innocent or curious, tempt them with their deepest desires

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to place the Priest anywhere within Very Far range and immediately spotlight them again.

When a PC within Close range of the Priest gains a Hope or marks HP, roll a d8. On a result of 8, the Priest opens a portal to their original dimension and flees there with the closest party member. You gain 1d6 Fear. The portal remains open until the Priest is defeated or spotlighted again.

descripcion: A huge eagle that's made of magical flame, impossible to kill, and hunted for its healing plumage.
motivos: Flee pursuers, live brilliantly, soar through the heavens, wield light and flame

rasgos.texto: Any PC who takes an action within the Phoenix's Melee range can spend a Hope to purify themself in its healing warmth, clearing a HP or a Stress and all conditions.
The Phoenix bleeds magic fire. When the Phoenix marks a HP, summon one Minor Fire Elemental within Very Close range.

When the Phoenix is defeated, it becomes a cloud of ash that blows away to reveal a Smoldering Egg. The Egg is immune to all damage and has a heat aura that deals **3d4** direct magic damage to anyone who touches it. The Egg hatches into a new Phoenix, with all HP and Stress cleared, in 7 days.

descripcion: A canoe-length marine lizard that has a long neck and four flippers.
motivos: Dive deeper, eat fish, swim peacefully

rasgos.texto: While deep underwater, the Plesiosaurus can't be located or targeted.

**Mark a Stress** to have the Plesiosaurus breach and crash, sending a wall of water from one side of its body. Each PC within Far range on that side of the Plesiosaurus must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (18) or take **3d10** physical damage and be pushed back to Far range.

descripcion: A giant falcon that nests in the mountains and unleashes storms.
motivos: Breathe lightning and speak thunder, protect eggs, rake with talons, spy from afar

rasgos.texto: The Roc can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.
Once per GM turn, the Roc can move up to Very Far range before or after it takes an action.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Roc unleash a storm of lightning and thunder. Make an attack roll against 1d4+1 targets within Far range. Targets the Roc succeeds against take **3d12** magic damage. Then each target within Far range of the Roc must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take **3d8** physical damage and are pushed back to Close range. Targets who succeed must **mark a Stress**.

When the Roc makes a successful standard attack, you can **mark a Stress** to have the Roc crush the target with its talons, forcing them to mark 1d4 Stress and Restraining them until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20).
When the Roc's eggs are threatened, it gains the following features:
The Roc gains a +2 bonus to its Difficulty and a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Stress it has marked.
The Roc has resistance to magic damage. PCs who fail a roll within Very Close range must spend a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

descripcion: A gargantuan burrowing worm that has armor plating and gnashing jaws. This intelligent and opportunistic hunter can swim through sand as quickly as a cheetah runs on land.
motivos: Ambush from below, eat and leave, tunnel and erupt, use both ends

rasgos.texto: **Mark a Stress** to attack a target within Close range. On a success, the target takes **3d10+2** physical damage and must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become _Restrained_ and _Vulnerable_ until they roll with Hope.

Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Sandwyrm Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is _Restrained_ and marks a HP when the Sandwyrm is spotlighted. The Sandwyrm disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or greater damage.
When the Sandwyrm marks half its HP or Swallows a creature, roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the Sandwyrm retreats to safety.

descripcion: An evil entity who impersonates a trusted figure.
motivos: Impersonate, sow discord, tempt betrayal

rasgos.texto: The Fiend has resistance to magic damage and can't be fooled by magic illusions.

**Spend a Fear** to have the Fiend magically transform into a humanoid they have previously interacted with. A PC who targets the Fiend while they're in the form of a person the PC cares for must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or the attack fails and the PC must **mark a Stress**.
**Mark a Stress** to make the Fiend _Hidden_ until they make an action roll or take damage.
